name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
summary: Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt asks you to deal with diseased wolves in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: At the Writhing Haunt
sections.body: At the Writhing Haunt in the Western Plaguelands, Mulgris Deepriver asks you to destroy eight Diseased Wolves, then return to him.

faq.answer: Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt asks you to destroy Diseased Wolves.

faq.q: What does Mulgris want me to do?
faq.answer: Mulgris Deepriver asks you to destroy eight Diseased Wolves and return to him.

faq.q: Where do I find Mulgris Deepriver?
faq.answer: Mulgris Deepriver is at the Writhing Haunt in the Western Plaguelands.
